argument: The refusal must be carried by several routes sharing one disappearance and one exit rhythm; the gap ring or coral witness cannot do the explanatory work.
With witnesses and labels hidden, a viewer should see a family of handwriting routes narrow, vanish, and re-emerge together. If it reads as a decorative missing patch, the mutation fails.
Placing a gap must alter route points and missing spans, not only a counter. Lifting the latest gap must reproduce the exact preceding field from pointer, button, and keyboard paths.

The contagious gap is an easy metaphor. Delete v006 if the after-route is indistinguishable from a generic wave field, if only one route bends, or if the copy explains more absence than the marks can show.
